programmes.name_local: Abono de Família para Crianças e Jovens
programmes.amount_note: Monthly amount depends on income tier (escalão), child age and household type. 2026: 1st tier €190.98 (<=36 months) / €75.13 (>36 months); 4th tier €88.43/€44.77; 5th tier no entitlement. Top-ups for single-parent (+35%), large families and Garantia para a Infância.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply within 6 months of the month after birth for full back-payment.

procedure_steps.detail: Log in to Segurança Social Direta
Go to Família > Abono de Família and submit the application (form RP 5045 at service desks)

eligibility.income_note: Income test uses the household reference income (rendimento de referência) = total annual gross income of the household ÷ (number of children entitled to abono + 1). For new applications in 2026 entitlement ends in the 5th escalão: reference income must be ≤ 2,5×IAS×14 = €18,287.50. income_annual_max shows the household-level equivalent for 1 child (18,287.50×2 = €36,575); add €18,287.50 per extra entitled child. Movable assets must be ≤ 240×IAS (€128,911.20).

programmes.source_snippet: Montantes 2026: €190.98 (1st tier, ≤36 months); €75.13 (1st tier, >36 months); updated +2.2% by Portaria 60/2026/1 (press reports of published portaria).

programmes.amount_note: 2026 values: €190.98 (1st tier), €161.65 (2nd), €132.07 (3rd), €88.43 (4th tier) per unborn child; +35% for single-parent households; doubles for twins.
programmes.deadline_note: Can be requested from the 13th week of pregnancy up to 6 months after birth.

procedure_steps.detail: From 2025, the pregnancy certificate can be shared electronically with Segurança Social via SNS 24, which generates an automatic proposal
Accept the proposal or apply via Segurança Social Direta

documents_required.doc: Medical pregnancy certificate (or SNS 24 electronic sharing)

eligibility.income_note: Income test uses the household reference income (rendimento de referência) = total annual gross income of the household ÷ (number of children entitled to abono (including the unborn child) + 1). For new applications in 2026 entitlement ends in the 5th escalão: reference income must be ≤ 2,5×IAS×14 = €18,287.50. income_annual_max shows the household-level equivalent for 1 child (18,287.50×2 = €36,575); add €18,287.50 per extra entitled child. Movable assets must be ≤ 240×IAS (€128,911.20).

programmes.source_snippet: 190,98 € por mês no 1.º escalão... A partir da 13.ª semana de gravidez.

programmes.name_local: Bonificação do Abono de Família para Crianças e Jovens com Deficiência
programmes.amount_note: 2026 values: €74.19 (up to 14 years), €108.06 (14-18), €144.63 (18-24). Added to the child allowance for children with certified disability.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via Segurança Social Direta or at a service desk

eligibility.income_note: Requires entitlement to abono de família (escalões 1-4). Same income test: reference income (annual household gross income ÷ (children + 1)) ≤ 2,5×IAS×14 = €18,287.50 in 2026; €36,575 household annual income for a 1-child household.

programmes.source_snippet: a bonificação por deficiência passa a ser de 74,19 euros para crianças e jovens até aos 14 anos, 108,06 euros para jovens com mais de 14 anos e 144,63 para jovens dos 18 aos 24 anos

programmes.name_local: Subsídio por Assistência de Terceira Pessoa
programmes.amount_note: €128.24/month (2026) for dependent children needing permanent third-person care.

eligibility.income_note: Requires entitlement to abono de família with bonificação por deficiência (escalões 1-4). Same income test: reference income ≤ 2,5×IAS×14 = €18,287.50 in 2026; €36,575 household annual income for a 1-child household.

programmes.source_snippet: o subsídio por assistência de terceira pessoa sobe 2,78 euros, para 128,24 euros mensais

programmes.amount_note: Percentage of reference remuneration: 120 days at 100%; 150 days at 80%; shared leave 150 days (120+30) at 100%, 180 days (150+30) at 83%, or 90% if the father takes 60 consecutive days. Minimum daily value ~€14.32 (2026). +2% in the Autonomous Regions.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply within 6 months of the birth.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at Segurança Social Direta > Família > Parentalidade

programmes.source_snippet: Se escolherem 120 dias recebem 100% da remuneração de referência... Se escolherem 150 dias recebem 80%.

programmes.amount_note: Means-tested parental allowance for parents without sufficient contributions. 2026: household income per person must be <= €429.70 and movable assets <= 240xIAS (€128,911.20).

eligibility.income_note: Means-tested: monthly reference income of the household (total monthly income ÷ equivalence scale 1 + 0.7 per adult + 0.5 per minor) must be ≤ 80% of IAS = €429.70 (2026). income_annual_max = €5,156 per equivalence unit per year (429.70×12).

programmes.source_snippet: Em 2026, o rendimento do agregado por pessoa tem de ser igual ou inferior a 429,70 euros, e o património mobiliário não pode ultrapassar 240 vezes o IAS.

programmes.amount_note: Same percentages and durations as the initial parental allowance for working parents who adopt.
programmes.source_snippet: Allowance equivalent to the initial parental subsidy for workers who adopt a child under 15.

programmes.amount_note: Guarantees a minimum total of €100/month (2025) per child in the 1st income tier, topping up the child allowance and prenatal allowance.

eligibility.income_note: Household must be in abono escalão 1 AND reference income (annual gross income ÷ (children + 1)) ≤ 0,35×IAS×14 = €2,631.94 (requests made in 2026). income_annual_max = household equivalent for 1 child (€5,264). Guaranteed minimum €127.33/month per child (reference value €1,528/year in 2026).

programmes.source_snippet: Complement ensuring a minimum €100/month per child for the most vulnerable households.

programmes.amount_note: €268.57 (2026), equal to 50% of the IAS, towards funeral costs of a family member.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply within 6 months of the death.
programmes.source_snippet: O montante do subsídio de funeral (...) é de 268,57 euros e corresponde a 50 % do indexante dos apoios sociais (IAS).

programmes.funder: Ministério do Trabalho, Solidariedade e Segurança Social / ISS
programmes.amount_note: Free attendance at non-profit (IPSS) crèches up to a set monthly fee and copayment in for-profit crèches.
programmes.source_snippet: Universal measures include the Creche Feliz programme covering crèche fees (ASE overview, avozdoalgarve.pt).

programmes.amount_note: Reference value: holder €237.25, each adult €166.08, each child €118.63; the benefit tops up household income to this reference. Granted for 12 months, renewable.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via Segurança Social Direta or at a service desk; sign the insertion contract

documents_required.doc: Proof of household income and composition

eligibility.income_note: 2026 reference value €247.56/month for the titular (+70% per additional adult, +50% per minor); RSI pays the difference to household income, so a single person qualifies with income below €247.56/month = €2,971/year. Movable assets must be ≤ 60×IAS = €32,227.80.

programmes.source_snippet: O valor de referência do RSI corresponde à soma dos seguintes valores: Pela pessoa titular - 237,25€ Por cada pessoa adulta - 166,08€ Por cada criança ou jovem com menos de 18 anos - 118,63€.

programmes.amount_note: 65% of reference remuneration; 2026 limits: minimum 1xIAS (€537.13; €617.70 = 1.15xIAS when base salary was at least the minimum wage), maximum 2.5xIAS (€1,342.83), capped at 75% of net reference remuneration. +10% for single-earner or dual-unemployed households with children.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply within 90 days of becoming unemployed; prior registration at IEFP required.

procedure_steps.detail: Register as unemployed at the employment centre (IEFP)
Apply via Segurança Social Direta > Emprego > Prestações de desemprego

eligibility.income_note: Requires 360 days of registered earnings in the 24 months before unemployment.

programmes.source_snippet: não pode ser superior a 2,5 X IAS (1 306,25€), nem inferior ao IAS (522,50€) (Guia Prático, 2025 values; 2026: €617.70 min / €1,342.83 max).

programmes.amount_note: Means-tested benefit after unemployment benefit exhaustion or without qualifying contributions. 2026: €537.13 (with family) or €429.70 (single).

eligibility.income_note: Condição de recursos: monthly income per person of the household (ponderation 1 / 0.7 per adult / 0.5 per minor) ≤ 80% of IAS = €429.70 (2026) → income_annual_max = €5,156 per equivalence unit/year. Movable assets ≤ 240×IAS = €128,911.20.

programmes.source_snippet: Subsídio social de desemprego (com agregado) 537,13 €; (isolado) 429,70 € (2026 values).

programmes.amount_note: Monthly top-up to bring annual income up to the reference value: €8,040/year for a single person (max €670/month) or €14,070/year for a couple (2026). Beneficiaries also get free co-payments on medicines (BAS).

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via Segurança Social Direta, Citizen Shops or ISS service centres

documents_required.doc: Proof of income and assets of the applicant (and spouse)

eligibility.income_note: 2026: gross annual income ≤ €8,040 (single) or ≤ €14,070 for a couple (both counted); income_annual_max is the couple/household ceiling. Children with income in the 4th abono tier or above exclude the applicant.

programmes.source_snippet: O valor a receber, por mês, corresponde a 1/12 vezes a diferença entre 8 040,00€ (valor de referência ... titular isolado) ou 14 070,00€ (casal) e o valor anual dos rendimentos.

programmes.amount_note: Means-tested non-contributory pension for people at/above the legal pension age without sufficient contributions; amount indexed to the IAS and updated annually.

eligibility.income_note: 2026: monthly gross income ≤ 40% of IAS = €214.85 (single) → income_annual_max = €3,008/year (214.85×14); couple limit 60% of IAS = €322.28/month (€4,512/year).

programmes.source_snippet: Non-contributory old-age pension for residents with insufficient social security contributions, subject to a means test.

programmes.amount_note: Means-tested non-contributory pension for people with total incapacity for work and insufficient contributions; replaced by the complement of the Prestação Social para a Inclusão for new cases.

eligibility.income_note: 2026: monthly gross income ≤ 40% of IAS = €214.85 (single) → income_annual_max = €3,008/year (214.85×14); couple limit 60% of IAS = €322.28/month (€4,512/year).

programmes.source_snippet: Non-contributory invalidity pension subject to a means test (legacy regime; PSI applies to new disability cases).

programmes.amount_note: Supplement for pensioners unable to perform daily activities without help: 1st degree (bedridden/severely dependent) and 2nd degree, with different IAS-indexed amounts.

eligibility.income_note: Requires medical certification of dependency (SVI verification system).

programmes.source_snippet: Supplement to pensions for dependent persons, paid at 1st or 2nd degree rates.

programmes.amount_note: Base component of 1xIAS (€537.13 in 2026) for people with a certified disability (>=60% incapacity) aged 18+, plus a complement component that tops up low incomes.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via Segurança Social Direta; disability is certified by the multi-purpose certificate (Atestado Médico de Incapacidade Multiuso)

eligibility.income_note: Base component (€4,003.68/year in 2026, adults) is not income-tested but its sum with work income cannot exceed €12,880/year (income_annual_max = accumulation ceiling for keeping the base). The complemento (max €670/month in 2026) is means-tested on household income (ponderation 1/0.7/0.5).

programmes.source_snippet: Base component of 1 IAS for persons with certified disability of at least 60%.

programmes.name_local: Subsídio de Apoio ao Cuidador Informal Principal
programmes.amount_note: Monthly allowance for the main informal carer who cannot work because of full-time caring duties; means-tested and capped by reference to the IAS. Under the Estatuto do Cuidador Informal (Law 93/2019).

procedure_steps.detail: Obtain recognition as main informal carer (Segurança Social Direta)
Submit the allowance application with income proof

eligibility.income_note: 2026: household monthly reference income (ponderation 1 / 0.7 per other adult / 0.5 per minor) must be < 1,3×IAS = €698.27 → income_annual_max = €8,379 per equivalence unit/year. Subsidy = €590.84 (1,1×IAS) minus reference income. From 2026 it no longer counts as income for other benefits (DL 138/2025).

programmes.source_snippet: Allowance paid to the main informal carer under the Estatuto do Cuidador Informal, subject to means-testing.

programmes.amount_note: Replaces income during certified sick leave: 55% to 75% of reference remuneration depending on duration; minimum daily values indexed to IAS.

eligibility.income_note: Requires 6 months of registered earnings; medical certificate (CIT) sent electronically by the doctor.

programmes.source_snippet: Sickness benefit of 55%-75% of reference remuneration according to the length of the sick leave.

programmes.amount_note: €40/month covering all public transport operators across the 18 municipalities of the Lisbon Metropolitan Area.
programmes.source_snippet: Monthly pass (Navegante Metropolitano): Covering the entire Lisbon Metropolitan Area, this pass costs €40 per month.

programmes.amount_note: €30/month valid on all operators within a single municipality of the Lisbon Metropolitan Area.
programmes.source_snippet: Monthly pass (Navegante Municipal): Valid within a single municipality, this pass costs €30 per month.

programmes.source_snippet: Metropolitan pass covering the whole Porto Metropolitan Area for €40/month (Andante Metropolitano).

programmes.amount_note: 25% discount on Navegante passes for households with income below defined thresholds, registered in Lisbon.

eligibility.income_note: For low-income households below the municipal threshold.

programmes.source_snippet: Municipal scheme granting discounted passes to low-income households (Passe Social+).

programmes.source_snippet: Youth (up to 25) and senior (65+) discounts of 25%/50% on CP long-distance and regional trains.

Return-trip caps no longer apply to the eligible ticket cost.

programmes.funder: Estado / DGEG / ERSE (financiada pelo sistema elétrico)
programmes.amount_note: 33.8% discount on regulated electricity tariffs (before VAT) in 2026, plus exemption from the special consumption tax (IEC) and reduced audiovisual contribution; applied automatically to eligible low-income households (contracted power <= 6.9 kVA).

eligibility.income_note: Eligibility: beneficiaries of RSI, CSI, abono de família, social unemployment benefit, pensão social de velhice or PSI complement; OR households with annual income ≤ €5,808 + 50% per additional member without income (max 10 people). income_annual_max = €5,808 base household threshold.

programmes.source_snippet: Em 2026, o desconto mantém-se em 33,8% por referência às tarifas transitórias do mercado regulado... A atribuição é, em regra, automática.

programmes.amount_note: ~31.2% discount on regulated natural gas tariffs (2026) for economically vulnerable consumers in the lowest consumption tier.

eligibility.income_note: Same economic-vulnerability criteria as the social electricity tariff: beneficiary of listed social benefits OR household annual income ≤ €5,808 + 50% per additional member without income (max 10).

programmes.source_snippet: Em média, o desconto da tarifa social na sua fatura de gás natural em 2026 é de 31,2% (sem taxas e impostos).

programmes.amount_note: €1,300 voucher (per household) for energy-efficiency works (windows, insulation, heat pumps, solar water heating) for owner-occupiers or tenants of homes eligible for the social energy tariff.

Apply online at the Fundo Ambiental portal

programmes.source_snippet: se for aprovada, receberá um vale de 1300 euros para melhorar a sua casa... As candidaturas encerram quando os 20.000 vales existentes forem distribuídos.

programmes.name_local: Programa de Apoio a Edifícios Mais Sustentáveis (PAES)

documents_required.doc: Quotes and technical specifications of the works

Register the rental contract at Portal das Finanças (or add it within 60 days of results)
IHRU replies within 45 working days

documents_required.doc: NIF and NISS of all applicants
Proof of income (previous year's IRS or last 3 payslips)

eligibility.income_note: Porta 65 Jovem: corrected monthly household income (RMC = gross monthly income ÷ equivalence scale 1 + 0.7 per additional adult + 0.25 per dependant) ≤ 4×SMN = €3,680 (2026, SMN €920) → income_annual_max = €44,160 for a single adult (higher with more members). programmes.source_snippet: Desde junho de 2023, as candidaturas funcionam em contínuo... jovens entre os 18 e os 35 anos.

programmes.funder: IHRU / Ministério das Infraestruturas e Habitação
programmes.amount_note: Landlords rent homes at least 20% below market reference values and get IRS/IRC exemption on rental income; tenants gain affordable rents with an effort rate capped by income band.

programmes.source_snippet: promove uma oferta alargada de habitação para arrendamento com rendas até 20% abaixo do valor de referência de mercado

programmes.source_snippet: IHRU rent subsidy for low-income tenant households under the subsidised rent regime.

programmes.amount_note: Up to €200/month for tenant households with an effort rate above 35% and income below set limits; extended to the end of 2026 (confirm current status at the housing portal).

eligibility.income_note: Household annual income ≤ 6th IRS bracket limit = €43,090 (2026); effort rate with rent ≥ 35%; contract signed by 15/03/2023 and registered with AT. Automatic benefit of €20–€200/month.

programmes.source_snippet: Apoio Extraordinário à Renda: permite receber até 200€ por mês, para famílias com maior taxa de esforço, até ao final de 2026.

programmes.name_local: 1.º Direito - Programa de Apoio ao Acesso à Habitação
programmes.amount_note: Financial support to municipalities, IPSS, residents' associations and directly to families living in undignified housing conditions (overcrowding, insalubrity, precarity) for rehabilitation, acquisition or rental solutions.

eligibility.income_note: For households in severe housing deprivation; applications mostly via municipalities and partner entities.

programmes.source_snippet: apoia famílias que vivem em condições indignas — precariedade, insalubridade, sobrelotação, inadequação face a necessidades específicas

programmes.source_snippet: Ter 35 anos ou menos na data da escritura; Comprar a primeira habitação própria e permanente; limite do 4.º escalão do IMT (316.772 € em 2024, 324.058 € em 2025).

programmes.source_snippet: Municipal social housing allocated to low-income households at income-related rents (renda apoiada).

programmes.source_snippet: Education expenses deducted at 30% up to €800 per household per year (CIRS art. 78-D).

programmes.amount_note: 15% of rent paid on a permanent home deducted from IRS up to €502/year (general cap; higher for lower incomes).
programmes.source_snippet: Rent for permanent housing deducted at 15% up to €502 per year (CIRS art. 78-F).

programmes.name_local: IMI Familiar (Redução de IMI por Dependentes)
programmes.amount_note: Fixed reduction of the municipal property tax (IMI) for owner-occupied homes with dependent children: €20 (1 child), €40 (2), €70 (3+), where the municipality opts in.
programmes.source_snippet: Fixed IMI reduction per dependent for permanent owner-occupied homes (IMI familiar).

programmes.name_local: IFICI - Incentivo Fiscal à Investigação Científica e Inovação (sucessor do RNH)
programmes.name_en: IFICI Tax Incentive (successor to Non-Habitual Resident regime)
programmes.funder: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira / AICEP / ANI
programmes.amount_note: 20% flat IRS rate on net employment/professional income for new tax residents in qualified research, teaching and high-value-added activities, for 10 years. The old RNH regime is closed to new applicants since 2024.
programmes.deadline_note: Registration deadlines apply after becoming a tax resident.

eligibility.income_note: For new tax residents in listed qualified professions who were not resident in the previous 5 years.

programmes.source_snippet: O regime do Residente Não Habitual (RNH) está a ser gradualmente substituído pelo IFICI... aplica uma taxa reduzida de 20%.

programmes.name_local: Bolsa de Estudo do Ensino Superior (DGES - Ação Social)
programmes.amount_note: Annual grant paid in 10 monthly instalments: minimum €871.25 (125% of the max tuition fee, 2025/26) up to €5,981.73, depending on household income; covers tuition, food and lodging costs.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply when applying to higher education or at the institution's social services (SAS), usually by 30 September.

procedure_steps.detail: Request access credentials during the higher-education application or at the SAS
Submit the online application with household income documents

documents_required.doc: Citizen card of applicant and household

eligibility.income_note: 2025/26: annual per capita household income must be below 23×IAS = €12,017.50; income_annual_max shows a 2-person household equivalent (€24,035) — multiply €12,017.50 by household size. Movable assets ≤ 240×IAS = €125,400 (IAS 2025).

programmes.source_snippet: o valor mínimo a receber deste apoio é de 871,25 euros anuais e o valor máximo estabelecido é de 5 981,73 euros.

programmes.name_local: Complemento de Alojamento para Estudantes Deslocados
programmes.funder: DGES / SAS das instituições de ensino superior
programmes.amount_note: Monthly accommodation supplement for grant-holding students studying away from home, towards actual lodging costs up to a regulatory cap (€342.50/month in 2025/26 reference).

eligibility.income_note: Requires a DGES study grant as a displaced student: same income rule — per capita household income < 23×IAS = €12,017.50/year (2025/26); income_annual_max = 2-person household equivalent (€24,035).

programmes.source_snippet: Accommodation supplement paid to displaced scholarship students on top of the DGES grant.

programmes.amount_note: Annual mobility grant (€1,700 + tuition support) for students enrolling in public higher-education institutions in interior regions or selected polytechnic programmes.
programmes.deadline_note: Linked to the national higher-education application calendar.

eligibility.income_note: Requires a DGES study grant (deslocados): per capita household income < 23×IAS = €12,017.50/year (2025/26); income_annual_max = 2-person household equivalent (€24,035).

programmes.source_snippet: Annual mobility incentive for students moving to higher-education institutions in the interior (+Superior).

programmes.amount_note: Merit scholarship for higher-education students with exceptional grades, regardless of income; amount fixed annually by government order.

eligibility.income_note: Household annual gross income must be ≤ 9× the national minimum wage (SMN €920 in 2026) = €8,280/year, plus grade average ≥ 16.

programmes.source_snippet: Merit-based scholarship for students with outstanding academic performance in higher education.

programmes.amount_note: Free or subsidised school meals, school material, transport, accommodation and study visits for pupils in compulsory education whose families are in the 1st-3rd child-allowance income tiers (Escalões A/B/C).
programmes.deadline_note: Granted automatically via the child-allowance income tier.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm or apply for the child allowance tier with Segurança Social; the school applies ASE automatically

eligibility.income_note: ASE covers households in abono escalões 1-3 (escalões A-C): reference income (annual income ÷ (children + 1)) ≤ 1,7×IAS×14 = €12,435.50 (2026 requests) → income_annual_max = household equivalent with 1 child (€24,871).

programmes.source_snippet: refeições gratuitas ou comparticipadas, manuais escolares gratuitos, transporte, material escolar, alojamento, visitas de estudo... escalões A, B e C do abono de família.

programmes.amount_note: Free textbooks for all pupils in public schools through digital vouchers (MEGA platform / Edu Rede Escolar app), exchanged at participating bookshops; reuse encouraged.
programmes.deadline_note: Vouchers issued each school year; deadlines per school year.
programmes.source_snippet: State programme providing free textbooks to all pupils via MEGA vouchers redeemed in bookshops.

programmes.name_local: Bolsas de Estudo da Câmara Municipal de Lisboa
programmes.amount_note: Municipal study grants for Lisbon-resident higher-education students from low-income households, complementing state grants.

eligibility.income_note: Means-tested; residence in Lisbon required.

programmes.source_snippet: Municipal study grants for higher-education students resident in Lisbon with limited means.

programmes.amount_note: Reimbursement of up to €750 per candidate per 12-month period for digital-skills training (AI, cybersecurity, programming, digital marketing) delivered by DGERT-certified providers; paid after course completion.
programmes.deadline_note: Current phase: courses must be completed by 30 June 2026; check IEFP for reopening.

procedure_steps.detail: Enrol in an eligible course with a DGERT-certified provider
Submit the application at iefponline with tax/contribution clearance documents
Complete the course, close the process and receive the reimbursement

documents_required.doc: Proof of regularised tax and social security situation
SIGO course certificate and payment receipts

programmes.source_snippet: O apoio pode atingir um valor máximo de 750 euros por candidato e por ano... candide-se até 30 de junho de 2026.

programmes.amount_note: 9-month paid internships for unemployed young people (and career changers): IEFP co-funds the internship allowance (65% to 100% of 1 IAS, plus meal and insurance contributions) paid by the host entity.

procedure_steps.detail: Register at IEFP and apply for internship offers on the IEFP portal

eligibility.income_note: Internship allowance indexed to the IAS.

programmes.source_snippet: IEFP internship measure (Ativar.pt) co-funding internship allowances for registered unemployed.

programmes.amount_note: Financial support to employers hiring registered unemployed on permanent or fixed-term contracts (exemption/reduction of employer social-security contributions and/or cash premium), with higher support for disadvantaged groups.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications by the employer, within set periods after the contract starts.
programmes.source_snippet: IEFP hiring-incentive measure supporting permanent contracts for registered unemployed (Contrato-Emprego).

programmes.amount_note: Free vocational courses (Aprendizagem, EFA, CET, Lifelong Learning / Vida Ativa) for unemployed and workers, often with training, meal and transport allowances.
programmes.source_snippet: O IEFP mantém centenas de cursos gratuitos abertos a desempregados, trabalhadores e jovens em todo o país.

programmes.name_local: Centros Qualifica - RVCC e Qualificação de Adultos
programmes.amount_note: Free recognition, validation and certification of competences (RVCC) and adult education courses allowing adults to complete the 4th, 6th, 9th or 12th year of schooling or vocational qualifications.
programmes.source_snippet: o processo RVCC... disponível nos Centros Qualifica, permite obter equivalência ao 4.º, 6.º ou 9.º ano de escolaridade.

programmes.amount_note: Small loans (microcredit) with technical support for unemployed people and low-income entrepreneurs to create their own job or micro-business.
programmes.source_snippet: Microcredit lines supporting business creation by unemployed people and vulnerable entrepreneurs (IEFP/ANDC partnerships).

programmes.amount_note: Financial support (non-repayable and repayable components) for young entrepreneurs aged 18-35 to start a business and create their own job.
programmes.source_snippet: IEFP support programme financing business creation by young entrepreneurs aged 18-35.

programmes.amount_note: Monthly grant (c. €700) over up to 12 months for aspiring entrepreneurs developing a business idea, plus incubation support.
programmes.deadline_note: Calls open periodically on the IAPMEI portal.
programmes.source_snippet: Entrepreneurship grant for teams developing a new business idea (StartUP Voucher, StartUP Portugal).

programmes.name_local: SIFIDE II - Sistema de Incentivos Fiscais à I&D Empresarial
programmes.funder: ANI - Agência Nacional de Inovação / Autoridade Tributária
programmes.amount_note: Tax credit on corporate R&D expenditure: 32.5% base rate on current expenses plus up to 50% incremental rate, deducted from IRC.
programmes.source_snippet: Fiscal incentive system crediting business R&D expenses against corporate income tax (SIFIDE II).

programmes.amount_note: EU-co-funded grants for SME investment in innovation, digitalisation, internationalisation and energy transition, with non-repayable components up to set intensity rates.
programmes.deadline_note: Calls (avisos) open per region/theme throughout the programming period.
programmes.source_snippet: European-funds incentive schemes for company modernisation and innovation under Portugal 2030.

programmes.funder: Estado / Autoridade de Gestão do PEPAC (ex-IFAP)
programmes.amount_note: Installation premium for young farmers (18-40) setting up an agricultural holding; premium amounts vary by call (up to c. €70,000 depending on project type and region).
programmes.deadline_note: Applications during published PEPAC calls.
programmes.source_snippet: Installation support for young farmers under the PEPAC (Common Agricultural Policy strategic plan).

programmes.name_local: Cheque-Dentista (Programa Nacional de Promoção da Saúde Oral)
programmes.amount_note: €45 vouchers (2026) covering dental prevention, diagnosis and treatment acts at SNS-affiliated private clinics, issued by family doctors or schools to children at set ages, pregnant women, CSI beneficiaries and patients with specific conditions.

procedure_steps.detail: Ask your family doctor or school health service about voucher eligibility
Book an appointment at an affiliated dental clinic with the voucher

programmes.source_snippet: O valor de cada cheque, em 2026, corresponde a 45 euros... crianças, grávidas, idosos beneficiários do CSI e doentes com patologias específicas.

programmes.amount_note: User fees (taxas moderadoras) were abolished in the SNS from 2022: consultations, exams and emergency care in NHS facilities are free of charge.
programmes.source_snippet: Taxas moderadoras abolished in the SNS (since 2022); care is free at point of use.

programmes.amount_note: Free vaccines included in the PNV (childhood schedule, HPV, influenza for at-risk groups, COVID-19 campaigns, etc.) at health centres.
programmes.source_snippet: Vaccines in the National Vaccination Programme are free of charge in the SNS.

programmes.name_local: Rastreios Oncológicos do SNS (Mama, Colo do Útero, Colorretal)
programmes.funder: SNS / DGS / Liga Portuguesa Contra o Cancro (parceria)
programmes.amount_note: Free population-based screenings: breast cancer (mammography 45-69), cervical cancer (HPV test 25-64) and colorectal cancer (stool test 50-74), by invitation or via the health centre.
programmes.source_snippet: Organised cancer screenings (breast, cervical, colorectal) are free in the SNS for the target age groups.

programmes.name_local: Benefícios Adicionais de Saúde (BAS) para Beneficiários do CSI
programmes.name_en: Additional Health Benefits for CSI Recipients
programmes.amount_note: Free medicines for CSI beneficiaries: the State covers the non-reimbursed share of prescribed medicines (in force since June 2024).

eligibility.income_note: Benefício Adicional de Saúde tied to CSI beneficiaries: gross annual income ≤ €8,040 (single) / €14,070 (couple) in 2026.

programmes.source_snippet: gratuidade total dos medicamentos prescritos a estes idosos... denominada de Benefícios Adicionais de Saúde (BAS).

programmes.name_local: Rede Nacional de Cuidados Continuados Integrados (RNCCI)
programmes.name_en: National Network for Integrated Continuing Care
programmes.amount_note: Free or income-adjusted continuing-care places (convalescence, rehabilitation, long-term care) following clinical referral; accommodation copayment depends on income.

eligibility.income_note: Health component free; accommodation fee income-adjusted.

programmes.source_snippet: Integrated continuing care units and teams providing free clinical care after referral by SNS services.

programmes.funder: Ministério da Justiça / Instituto de Gestão Financeira e Equipamentos da Justiça
programmes.amount_note: Free or reduced-cost legal advice, court fees and lawyer appointment for people with insufficient means (insuficiência económica), assessed automatically against income thresholds.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at justica.gov.pt or at a court/citizen shop with income proof

eligibility.income_note: Means test (Lei 34/2004): monthly reference income (annual gross income ÷ 12 ÷ ponderation 1 + 0.7 per cohabiting adult + 0.5 per minor) must be ≤ 0.5×IAS = €268.57 (2026) → income_annual_max = €3,223/year for a single-person household; larger households have higher equivalents.

programmes.source_snippet: Legal aid ensuring access to law and courts for people with insufficient economic means (Lei 34/2004).

programmes.funder: CP - Comboios de Portugal / Estado Português
programmes.amount_note: €20 for 30 days (€40 for 60, €60 for 90); unlimited travel on Regional, InterRegional, Intercidades (2nd class, seat reservation) and urban trains outside intermodal pass areas. Not valid on Alfa Pendular.

procedure_steps.detail: Get a Cartão CP and buy the pass at cp.pt, the CP app or ticket offices

programmes.source_snippet: «Passe Ferroviário Verde – 30 dias – 20,00 €» — CP price list; in force since 21/10/2024.

programmes.amount_note: Broadband 12/2 Mbps, 15 GB/month at €6.15 (€5+VAT); router €26.38 payable in instalments. Created by DL 66/2021.

procedure_steps.detail: Fill in the TSI form with a participating operator (e.g. MEO, NOS, Vodafone, Digi); ANACOM validates eligibility

documents_required.doc: Proof of social benefit or income

eligibility.income_note: For beneficiaries of RSI, CSI, abono de família, unemployment benefits, pensão social de velhice/invalidez or PSI complement; OR households with annual income ≤ €5,808 + 50% per additional member without income (max 10); also university students in eligible households.

programmes.source_snippet: «O preço da Tarifa Social de Internet é 6,15€ (5€ + IVA)» — operator page describing the DL 66/2021 scheme.

programmes.name_local: Fundo de Emergência Social e de Recuperação de Lisboa (FES/RLX-AF)
programmes.name_en: Lisbon Social Emergency Fund — household support
programmes.funder: Câmara Municipal de Lisboa / Juntas de Freguesia
programmes.amount_note: Exceptional financial aid for households in severe housing need or economic emergency; limit €2,000 per household per year (€3,500 in justified exceptional cases, e.g. minors, elderly, disability). Cannot be combined with other CML aid for the same purpose.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at your Junta de Freguesia, which executes the fund under delegation from CML

eligibility.income_note: Discretionary means assessment by the freguesia for households in severe deprivation; no fixed national ceiling — annual cap is on the benefit (€2,000/household, €3,500 exceptional).

programmes.source_snippet: «tem como limite, por agregado familiar em cada ano, o valor de 2.000 euros... passa a corresponder a 3.500 euros» (regras FES LX–AF, Observador/Lusa 22/04/2026).

programmes.name_local: BIP/ZIP — Bairros e Zonas de Intervenção Prioritária de Lisboa
programmes.amount_note: Small grants (typically up to ~€7,500 per project) awarded by annual public competition to local associations, informal groups and residents for community projects in Lisbon’s priority neighbourhoods. Amount set in each year’s opening notice.
programmes.deadline_note: Annual competition window published in an Aviso de Abertura.

procedure_steps.detail: Submit a community project application on the BIP/ZIP portal during the annual window

eligibility.income_note: No income test — grants fund community projects in designated priority neighbourhoods (BIP/ZIP areas).

programmes.source_snippet: Long-running CML programme of public competitions funding grassroots projects in Bairros e Zonas de Intervenção Prioritária (e.g. Cozinha Popular da Mouraria).

programmes.funder: Instituto da Segurança Social dos Açores, I.P.R.A.
programmes.amount_note: Monthly supplement for low-income pensioners resident in the Azores to offset insularity costs; calculated by income tiers (escalões) and paid in 14 instalments per year. Values updated annually in the Azores regional budget.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at ISS Açores services or the Rede Integrada de Apoio ao Cidadão (RIAC)

eligibility.income_note: Restricted to pensioners with low income resident in the Azores; eligibility set by regional income tiers (escalões de rendimento) updated annually — no single national ceiling published.

programmes.source_snippet: «benefício adicional concedido aos pensionistas residentes nas Regiões Autónomas dos Açores para mitigar os custos adicionais da insularidade... É calculado com base em escalões de rendimentos e é pago em 14 mensalidades» (seg-social.pt).

programmes.name_local: Programa Regressar — benefício fiscal para ex-residentes (art. 12.º-A CIRS)
programmes.name_en: Regressar Programme — tax benefit for returning emigrants
programmes.funder: Autoridade Tributária e Aduaneira / Governo de Portugal
programmes.amount_note: 50% of employment/self-employment income excluded from IRS for 5 consecutive years, capped at €250,000/year, for taxpayers who become tax-resident in Portugal in 2024-2026 after ≥5 years abroad. IEFP financial reinstallation aid (up to 7×IAS = €3,759.91 + family/interior top-ups) had applications until 31/03/2026.
programmes.deadline_note: Tax regime applies to those becoming tax residents up to 31/12/2026; financial support window closed 31/03/2026.

procedure_steps.detail: Become tax resident in Portugal and opt into the regime in the IRS return (Modelo 3)

eligibility.income_note: Art. 12.º-A CIRS former-residents benefit: 50% of employment and self-employment income is exempt, applied to annual income up to EUR 250,000 (the excess gets no exemption). Requires becoming Portuguese tax resident in 2024, 2025 or 2026, not having been resident in the previous five years, and a regularised tax position. This is a cap on the benefited income rather than a hard eligibility cut-off.

programmes.source_snippet: «O Benefício Fiscal para Ex-residentes ao abrigo do Artigo 12.º A do CIRS, que exclui de tributação 50% dos rendimentos do trabalho... mantém-se em vigor até 31 dezembro de 2026» (Portal das Comunidades/MNE).

programmes.name_local: Emprego Interior MAIS — Mobilidade Apoiada para um Interior Sustentável
programmes.amount_note: 2026 (IAS €537.13): 7×IAS = €3,759.91 for permanent contract/business creation, 5×IAS = €2,685.65 for fixed-term ≥12 months; +20% per household member moving; up to 1.5×IAS (€805.70) for moving costs. Portaria 174/2020.

procedure_steps.detail: Be registered with IEFP (unemployed or seeking a new job) and apply via iefponline when taking a job in a designated interior territory

documents_required.doc: Work contract or business creation proof

eligibility.income_note: No income test; requires IEFP registration, regularised tax/social-security situation and relocation to an interior territory (Portaria 208/2017) for ≥12 months.

programmes.source_snippet: «Apoio financeiro atribuído pelo IEFP, IP aos trabalhadores que celebrem contratos de trabalho... ou criem o seu próprio emprego ou empresa, cujo local de trabalho implique a sua mobilidade geográfica para território do interior» (Portaria 174/2020 ficha de síntese IEFP).

programmes.name_local: SAPA — Sistema de Atribuição de Produtos de Apoio
programmes.funder: Instituto da Segurança Social, I.P. / INR, I.P.
programmes.amount_note: 100% co-funding of prescribed assistive products on the homologated list (wheelchairs, articulated beds, wigs, orthoses, etc.) when not covered by health subsystems or insurers; otherwise covers the difference. Subject to annual ISS budget.

procedure_steps.detail: Obtain a prescription fiche from a recognised prescriber centre and submit the application with 3 quotes to the district social security centre

documents_required.doc: Ficha de prescrição and 3 itemised quotes (ISO codes)

eligibility.income_note: No income test: requires certified disability ≥60% (or complemento por dependência 1st/2nd degree pensioners).

programmes.source_snippet: «A comparticipação do ISS, IP corresponde a 100% do custo do PA, quando este não for comparticipado por outros subsistemas de saúde ou Empresa de Seguros» (Guia SAPA/DL 93/2009).

programmes.funder: Instituto Nacional para a Reabilitação, I.P. / entidades gestoras (SCML, CRPG, etc.)
programmes.amount_note: Free loan (comodato) of reconditioned assistive products — wheelchairs, walkers, shower chairs — for people with disability or temporary need, while SAPA funding is pending or for short-term use.

procedure_steps.detail: Request through a Banco de Ajudas Técnicas (e.g. SCML Lisboa, rehabilitation centres) with a health professional referral

eligibility.income_note: No income test; access based on disability/incapacity and product availability.

programmes.source_snippet: Assistive-product loan banks operate under the national SAPA framework (DL 93/2009) managed by the INR with partner entities.

programmes.amount_note: 2026: percentage of the social pension (€262.40): 20% (€52.48, one surviving parent) up to 80% (€209.92, three or more orphans, no surviving spouse pensioner). Non-contributory (deceased not covered by social protection).
programmes.deadline_note: Apply within 6 months of the month after death for payment from that month.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at Segurança Social services (form RP 5001) within 6 months

eligibility.income_note: Condição de recursos: orphan’s monthly gross income ≤ 40% of IAS = €214.85 AND total monthly household income ≤ 1.5×IAS = €805.70 (2026) → income_annual_max = €9,668/year household (805.70×12); in risk/dysfunction households, €214.85 per person.

programmes.source_snippet: «Rendimentos ilíquidos mensais iguais ou inferiores 214,85 € (corresponde a 40% do valor do IAS), desde que o rendimento do respetivo agregado familiar não seja superior a 805,70 € (corresponde a 1,5xIAS). Valor do IAS para 2026: 537,13 €» (gov.pt).

programmes.amount_note: 2026: 60% of the social pension (€262.40) = €157.44/month, for surviving spouse/partner of a person not covered by any social protection scheme.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply within 6 months of death for payment from the following month.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at Segurança Social services (form RP 5018-DGSS)

eligibility.income_note: Monthly gross income ≤ 40% of IAS = €214.85 (2026) → income_annual_max = €3,008/year (214.85×14). Must not be entitled to any other pension.

programmes.source_snippet: «não pode ter rendimentos mensais brutos... que ultrapassem os 214,85 euros, o equivalente a 40% do IAS»; valor €157,44 = 60% da pensão social (Observador/MTSS, 2026).

programmes.amount_note: 60% of the deceased’s retirement/invalidity pension (or 80% with two entitled survivors, 100% with three or more). For spouses/partners or ex-spouses with alimony rights of beneficiaries of the general contributory scheme.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at Segurança Social Direta or service desks within 6 months (RP 5018-DGSS)

eligibility.income_note: No income test for the contributory widow’s pension; the deceased must have met the qualifying contribution period (prazo de garantia).

programmes.source_snippet: Contributory survivor’s pension set at 60% of the deceased beneficiary’s pension (Segurança Social guide).

programmes.name_local: Subsídio por Cessação de Atividade (trabalhadores independentes)
programmes.amount_note: 2026: ~65% of reference remuneration, between IAS (€537.13; min shown is the IAS of the contribution year basis) and 2.5×IAS (€1,342.83). Variants: economically dependent independents (DL 12/2013) and independents with business activity / managers (720 days in 48 months).
programmes.deadline_note: Apply within 90 days of activity cessation.

procedure_steps.detail: Register at the employment centre and submit the application (RP 5066-DGSS for business-activity independents) within 90 days

eligibility.income_note: Contributory benefit — no means test on the main subsidy (a social variant requires household per capita income ≤ 80% of IAS).

programmes.source_snippet: «prazo de garantia: 720 dias de exercício de atividade... num período de 48 meses imediatamente anterior à data da cessação da atividade» (gov.pt).

programmes.name_local: Subsídio por Frequência de Estabelecimento de Educação Especial
programmes.amount_note: Monthly allowance for children and young people up to 24 with disability attending special-education establishments, to offset the extra costs.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply at Segurança Social services with proof of enrolment in a special-education establishment

documents_required.doc: Proof of enrolment in special education

eligibility.income_note: No income test; requires certified disability and attendance of a special-education establishment.

programmes.source_snippet: Monthly Segurança Social allowance for minors/young people with disability attending special-education establishments.

programmes.funder: IAPMEI / StartUP Portugal (SI Empreendedorismo Qualificado e Criativo)
programmes.amount_note: Covers incubation services (management, marketing, legal advice, product development, fundraising) provided by accredited incubators to micro/small companies under one year old; support granted as a voucher for incubation services.
programmes.deadline_note: Application windows opened under Portugal 2030 calls.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply via IAPMEI/Balcão dos Fundos with an accredited incubator during an open call

eligibility.income_note: No income test — company-based support for firms under one year old.

programmes.source_snippet: «apoios a projetos simplificados de empresas com menos de um ano... contratação de serviços de incubação prestados por incubadoras de empresas previamente acreditadas» (IAPMEI programme description).

programmes.name_local: IFRRU 2020 — Instrumento Financeiro para a Reabilitação e Revitalização Urbanas
programmes.funder: IHRU / entidades gestoras, BEI, Banco de Desenvolvimento do Conselho da Europa, BPF
programmes.amount_note: Loans on better-than-market terms (amount and maturity per project) for full rehabilitation of buildings ≥30 years old (or in poor condition) within municipal Urban Rehabilitation Areas (ARU), including energy-efficiency measures; open to any public or private entity. Successor IFRRU 2030 designed under Portugal 2030 (RCM 180/2023).
programmes.deadline_note: Applications continuous via selected banks with prior municipal opinion.

procedure_steps.detail: Obtain prior binding municipal opinion and apply through an IFRRU partner bank

eligibility.income_note: No income test — financing instrument for building owners/investors in ARU areas.

programmes.source_snippet: «O IFRRU 2020 disponibiliza empréstimos em condições mais favoráveis face às do mercado, para a reabilitação integral de edifícios... CANDIDATURAS ABERTAS» (Portal da Habitação).

programmes.funder: Direção-Geral dos Estabelecimentos Escolares (DGEstE) / Ministério da Educação
programmes.amount_note: Free school lunch (and other meals per school offer) for pupils in ASE escalões A and B during the school year; escalão C pays a reduced price.
programmes.deadline_note: Confirmed automatically each school year from abono tier data; schools may require an ASE declaration.

procedure_steps.detail: Enrolment is automatic for pupils in abono escalões 1-2; confirm with the school

eligibility.income_note: Free for ASE escalões A and B = abono escalões 1-2: reference income (annual income ÷ (children + 1)) ≤ 1×IAS×14 = €7,315 (2026 requests) → income_annual_max = €14,630 household annual income with 1 child.

programmes.source_snippet: ASE grants «refeições gratuitas ou comparticipadas» to pupils in abono escalões 1-3 (escalões A-C).

programmes.name_local: ADSE — subsistema de saúde dos trabalhadores do Estado
programmes.amount_note: Health subsystem giving free/co-paid access to a conventioned network (consultations, exams, hospital care); funded by a 3.5% payroll contribution. Beneficiaries: central-administration employees and pensioners.

procedure_steps.detail: Enrolment via employer; access conventioned providers with the ADSE card

eligibility.income_note: No income test — eligibility derives from employment in the public administration (3.5% payroll discount).

programmes.source_snippet: ADSE is the health subsystem for state employees and pensioners with conventioned-network coverage.

programmes.name_en: Free Andante school passes (Porto metropolitan area)
programmes.funder: TIP — Transportes Intermodais do Porto / AMP
programmes.amount_note: Free Andante travel for pupils/students aged 4-18 (escola.tp) and university students up to 23 (sub23@escola.tp) enrolled in the Porto metropolitan area.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply before each school/academic year via the escola.tp online form.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on the escola.tp platform with school/university data and an Andante card

eligibility.income_note: No income test — free for pupils/students by age and enrolment in the Porto metropolitan area.

programmes.source_snippet: TIP provides free Andante titles (4_18@escola.tp and sub23@escola.tp) for students in the Área Metropolitana do Porto.

programmes.name_local: Isenção de IMI para famílias de baixos rendimentos (EBF art. 9.º)
programmes.amount_note: Full IMI exemption while conditions hold for a permanent owner-occupied home: household gross income ≤ 2.3×IAS×14 (€17,295.77 in 2026) and taxable property value (VPT) ≤ 10×125×IAS (€671,412.50 in 2026).

procedure_steps.detail: Automatic: AT applies the exemption after cross-checking income (IRS) and VPT

eligibility.income_note: Household gross annual income ≤ 2.3×IAS×14 = €17,295.77 (IAS 2026 = €537.13); property VPT must be ≤ 10×125×IAS = €671,412.50.

programmes.source_snippet: EBF art. 9.º: IMI exemption for permanent homes where the household gross income ≤ 2,3×IAS×14 and VPT within the legal cap.

programmes.amount_note: Contributory old-age pension from the normal retirement age (66 years 9 months in 2026) with at least 15 years of contributions; amount based on contribution record.
programmes.deadline_note: Apply from 3 months before reaching the retirement age.

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on Segurança Social Direta (Pensões > Pensão de velhice)

eligibility.income_note: No income test — contributory right; the social (non-contributory) variant is listed separately.

programmes.source_snippet: Normal old-age pension age in 2026: 66 years and 9 months (Segurança Social guides).

programmes.amount_note: Contributory pension for permanent incapacity for work (relative or absolute invalidity), based on the contribution record; requires certified incapacity and prazo de garantia of 5 years (relative) / 3 years (absolute).

procedure_steps.detail: Apply on Segurança Social Direta; incapacity verified by the Sistema de Verificação de Incapacidades

eligibility.income_note: No income test — contributory right; the social (non-contributory) variant is listed separately.

programmes.source_snippet: Contributory invalidity pension requires prazo de garantia of 5 (relative) or 3 (absolute) calendar years with registered earnings.
